subject: RFP: Audit record delivery SLAs & evidence bundle clarifications
body:
From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@finbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: security-rfp@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP questions: audit record delivery SLA and evidence bundle

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the RFP. A couple of clarifications from our security and procurement teams around audit logs and preservation:

1) Delivery SLA: For regulatory requests we need an auditable extract within a firm SLA (ideally 72 hours). Can you confirm the typical turnaround and the format(s) you can deliver (bulk JSON, S3 tarball, CSV)?

2) Scope & provenance: We have questions about what metadata is preserved with logs (request id, model version, tenant id, timestamp with timezone, redaction flags). What fields are included in your standard audit record?

3) Tamper evidence: Do you provide integrity checks (hash manifests, signed bundles) for snapshots delivered to customers?

4) Retention windows: How are retention windows enforced across Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments? Which controls allow us to set retention per-tenant?

Can you point us to an example evidence bundle or schema? If you prefer, Tim from Procurement (copied) can take the delivery SLA language and slot it into our procurement template.

Appreciate the help — Alice

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, security-rfp@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP questions: audit record delivery SLA and evidence bundle

Hi Alice — thanks for the detailed list. Quick summary answers below; attaching a short evidence matrix and our retention summary. Long answers and examples follow.

- SLA (turnaround): Standard evidence extraction for Hosted customers is 72 hours for non-legal emergency requests; forDedicated and Private we can support 24–72 hours depending on the committed support tier and whether an on-prem extractor is included. We can contractually commit to 72 hours in the SOW or move to 24 hours for Dedicated with an escalation addendum.
- Formats: We deliver bulk exports as compressed S3 bundles (gzipped tar) with a manifest. Inside: newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) for events, CSV for index tables, and an optional Parquet path for analytics-ready datasets.
- Metadata preserved: request_id, timestamp (ISO8601 with timezone), model_id/model_version, route_id, tenant_id, response_status, token_counts, kv-cache markers for generation sessions, and a redaction flag + redaction_reason field when content is suppressed.
- Tamper evidence: We include a SHA-256 manifest and can provide signed manifests (PKI) as part of Dedicated/Private packages. For Hosted we provide manifest hashes and a notarization option (partnering HSM) as an add-on.
- Retention controls: Retention is enacted at the workspace/tenant level. Hosted: retention policies are enforced via automated lifecycle jobs with immutable snapshots stored for the retention period. Dedicated: policies can be configured and applied by the customer admin with optional retention lock. Private: fully customer-controlled.

Attachments: redwood-audit-evidence-matrix.xlsx, retention-policy-summary.pdf

Detailed notes (for procurement/security text):

1) Evidence delivery SLA examples (text you can paste into contract):
- "Redwood will make reasonable efforts to provide a complete extract of audit records related to the Customer's workspace within seventy-two (72) hours of a verified request. For Dedicated and Private deployments, Redwood will provide extracts within twenty-four (24) hours where Customer has purchased the expedited evidence delivery addendum."

2) Export structure & example fields (NDJSON event sample):
- timestamp
- request_id
- tenant_id
- user_id (if present)
- model_id
- model_version
- route_id
- event_type (request|response|audit_action)
- payload_reference (pointer to storage)
- redaction_flag & redaction_reason

3) Chain of custody & integrity
- Each bundle contains: MANIFEST.sha256, MANIFEST.sig (if signed), and a delivery metadata file (delivery.json) listing who requested, who delivered, and proof-of-delivery timestamps.

If you'd like we can also provide a short sample NDJSON (redacted) so you can validate ingestion processes.

Let me know if these answers cover it; Marissa and Kim are looped in for any legal/ops constraints.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-audit-evidence-matrix.xlsx)
(attachment: retention-policy-summary.pdf)

Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Audit evidence matrix + proposed SLA language (FB-2027-1447)

Hi Alice / Tim —

Attached is an updated evidence matrix with explicit field lists and an example bundle manifest. Per Marissa's note, we've included two options for manifest integrity in the matrix:
- Option A (standard Hosted): SHA-256 manifest + manifest hash shared via secure link.
- Option B (expedited / Dedicated / Private): Signed manifest (PKI) with signature verification instructions and HSM-backed key management.

Proposed contract clause for evidence delivery (editable):
"Redwood will provide an auditable export of audit records and associated artifacts within seventy-two (72) hours of a verified request from Customer, delivered as a compressed archive to a mutually agreed secure staging location (S3 bucket or equivalent). The archive includes an integrity manifest (SHA-256). For customers that purchase the Evidence Signing Addendum or operate in Dedicated/Private Mode, Redwood will provide a signed manifest; signature verification instructions will be documented in the delivery package."

We can also narrow the SLA to 48 hours for Dedicated with the expedited addendum; cost/terms are in the matrix.

If the FinBank security team wants sample NDJSON rows, we can produce a redacted sample bundle within 24 hours of a signed NDA — standard ops practice.

Best regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-audit-evidence-matrix.xlsx)

Vanessa — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick follow-ups for our GC:
- Can you confirm whether the signed-manifest option includes a retention of signing logs for 2 years?
- For Hosted customers, will the manifest-hash delivery link be time-limited and auditable (we want proof that Redwood handed off the bundle at a point in time)?

Tim and I will review the matrix and circle back with any contractual edits. If possible, send the redacted NDJSON sample under NDA and we'll validate ingestion.

Thanks again — Alice
